entries.offset: Salary still owed after a dismissal without cause is reduced dollar for dollar by pay earned in another NFL or major-college coaching job during the guaranteed period

dismissal.without_cause: The scheduled salary for the term is owed, less the offset
dismissal.for_cause: Cause is limited to a material employment breach; poor results, a losing season or a football disagreement are not cause

terms: No added title, roster power or additional hires
